pr_title: EVP_{CIPHER,MD}_CTX_ctrl(): make sure to return 0 or 1
pr_body:
Even thought the underlying calls might return something other than 0
or 1, `EVP_CIPHER_CTX_ctrl()` and `EVP_MD_CTX_ctrl()` were made to only
return those values regardless.  That behaviour was recently lost, so
we need to restore it.

Fixes #10106
pr_comments:
Merged.

552be00d429dc3d6c95bb2d9573b09e67485afb3 EVP_{CIPHER,MD}_CTX_ctrl(): make sure to return 0 or 1
Correction is not complete. It fixes final use of parameters but there is some "intermediate" cases.
For instance in case of EVP_CTRL_AEAD_TLS1_AAD ( see - https://github.com/openssl/openssl/blob/e78253f2d0c1a9fe6b023d867ee02342b4560150/crypto/evp/evp_enc.c#L1129 ) code should be same as proposed correction in this "pull" requires.

Next is another number of cases.
```c
    case EVP_CTRL_SET_PIPELINE_OUTPUT_BUFS: /* Used by DASYNC */
    case EVP_CTRL_INIT: /* TODO(3.0) Purely legacy, no provider counterpart */
    default:
        return EVP_CTRL_RET_UNSUPPORTED;
```

So default should be-  return zero with respective reason.

Next is EVP_CTRL_INIT: not sure what to return but comment indicates that "Success" is more correct. If control is no-op now why to return error?

And remain EVP_CTRL_SET_PIPELINE_OUTPUT_BUFS - no idea (requires additional more detailed review of use)


See #10163

issue_context.title: restore non-negative return value of EVP_CIPHER_CTX_*() in master
issue_context.body:
Issue is mainly for EVP_CIPHER_CTX_ctrl() but review of history shows that may some other functions are impacted - start is commit 13273237a65d46186b6bea0b51aec90670d4598a , dated  Tue, 9 Jul 2019 07:32:16 +0200.

Before switch to provider most of public function are "boolean like", i.e. never return negative value and zero as error indicator. In consequence many projects use "if ( !foo() )" calls to check for error.

Changes in this are of widely user API is like to open "Pandora's box".
Please restore original "preprovider" functionality.

I also think that in case of error public function should return -1 or negative value but this could be done with new api EVP_XCIPHER...
comments: Issue is related to #9524 (aes{128|256}-gcm failures in master 2019-08-03) , i.e.  correction of this will expose right failure.

Report was for fore then one function.
Unfortunately I did not have enough time to check current each function impacted by commit mentioned in first post. For instance quick review of commit shows changes in block size, length and etc.

Issues in control function are  more then one . - so I will comment in #10108 .

review_comments:
'conclude'? A very unusual label name... Why not 'finish' or 'done'?

```
~/src/openssl$ for w in conclude finish done ret; do echo -n "$w: "; git grep "goto[[:space:]]\+\<$w\>" | wc -l ; done
conclude: 0
finish: 59
done: 209
ret: 19
```
But if you prefer the name, never mind. Eh bien, chacun à son goût!
I find it expressive...  and it's internal, so.
Also, it's a name that's only valid within that function, so it's not even like it's exposing a bad internal API...
Consistency in the source base is important.  Cuteness is not.
